description_en: Modifies the hostname of a Windows cloud desktop in an AD workspace
description_zh: 修改AD办公网络下的Windows云电脑的主机名称
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-desktop-host-name --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --new-host-name NewName --desktop-id ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --desktop-ids example-string --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDesktopHostName

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the available regions for Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The new hostname of the cloud desktop. The hostname must meet the following requirements:

- The hostname must be 2 to 15 characters in length.

- The hostname can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It cannot start or end with a hyphen, contain consecutive hyphens, or consist of only digits
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的云电脑主机名称。主机名称的命名规则如下：

- 长度为2\~15个字符。
- 支持大小写字母、数字或者短划线（-）。不能以短划线开头或者结尾，不能连续使用短划线，不能只使用数字
parameters.name: new_host_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud desktop
parameters.name: desktop_id
